what: On a dark stage (WebGL, fov 50), 72 semi-transparent (.4) square photo panels stand in a cylinder around the camera, 18 per ring in four rings (spacing 6). Each slot is 20° apart, with horizontal radius 22 and random depth 22–44. The panels turn .001rad per frame and each bobs ±.5 on a 2–4s period. In the middle floats a wireframe globe, bumpy like landmasses (rotating .002rad/frame), with a radius 2.05 video disc in front. The mouse is followed late by .1 per frame: panels shift sideways .5–1 and up .5, while the globe and disc shift only a 10° share (.17). Given intro-dur, on attach the camera pulls back from z 6 to 8 on power4.out (original in() 3s — the original Hero never calls it, so the default is straight to 8). On receiving fx:globe the panels and disc vanish and only the globe remains as a white mass (fx:all brings them back) — the ”Region → World” stage of a music company Hero

options.count · row: Panel count · panels per row, default 72 · 18
options.radius · depth: Cylinder horizontal radius · depth range ‹min,max›, default 22 · 22,44
options.row-gap · y · step: Row spacing · cylinder height · angle between panels (degrees), default 6 · -9 · 20
options.size · opacity · bob: Panel side · opacity · sway width, default 3 · .4 · .5
options.spin · globe-spin: Angle turned per frame (rad) — panel cylinder · globe, default .001 · .002 (0 stops)
options.follow: Share of mouse following (per frame), default .1
options.disc · globe: Disc video radius · Earth radius, default 2.05 · 2.25
options.fov · cam: Camera field of view · distance, default 50 · 8
options.intro-from · intro-dur · ease · delay: Camera start distance on entry · duration (seconds) · Curve · delay, default 6 · 0 (instant) · power4.out · 0 — original in() is 3
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (if present) video (muted loop) to project on the disc — if absent, a placeholder screen flowing in the skin color. data-label is the placeholder text
options.[data-fx-part=item]: (if present) panel cover slot — data-tone (0~5) picks the skin color branch. If absent, eight skin-color cover branches
options.--fx-bg · --fx-wire: Stage background · globe line color (via style), default --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.fx:globe · fx:all: Events sent to the element — keep only the globe · show all (the original keeps only the globe when entering the video section)
options.class=\"fx-hold\": <html> Stops drawing once it reaches this point

note: three (window.THREE) must be loaded first — put three-global.js before three.cjs. Each panel stands facing the inside of the cylinder according to its angle, so the camera must be inside the cylinder (closer than the radius) to be surrounded as in the original
